standard_prerequisites.name: Flat pullback of the divisor of a rational function
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter chow.tex, label lemma-flat-pullback-principal-divisor, invoked at proof line 4272 and claimed as S14-algebra-flat-pullback-principal
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives the equality of cycles for principal divisors, which is the local model to which the general statement is reduced.

core_obligations: Reduce to an equality of divisors: choose a nonzero meromorphic section of the invertible sheaf on the base and show the stronger statement that the flat pullback of its divisor equals the divisor of the pulled back section (proof lines 4249-4253).

Work locally where the section is a generator: at a point choose a generator of the invertible sheaf over a neighbourhood, write the section as a rational function times it, and identify the divisor of the section with the divisor of that function, both on the base and on the source after pullback (proof lines 4254-4269).
Conclude by the principal divisor case (proof lines 4270-4272).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to divisors of sections (proof lines 4249-4253).
Identify locally with principal divisors (proof lines 4254-4269).
Apply the principal divisor statement (proof lines 4270-4272).
difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the flat pullback of the first Chern class of an invertible sheaf against the fundamental class of an integral scheme as the first Chern class of the pulled back sheaf against the fundamental class of the source (statement lines 4236-4247, tag 02SH-adjacent). The proof proves the stronger statement for the divisors of a meromorphic section, reduces locally to the case of a generator where the divisor is that of a rational function, and applies the principal divisor statement. The local reduction is the substance, so the claim is H2.
